summary: Iteration 43 — Compliance Posture control mapping + AI Analyst everywhere + clickable-cards-with-AI. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests PASS (advisor/fix control entity, advisor/insight per-dashboard, /explain, FAIR vs Register differ). Frontend: verified live on 1600x1000 with jblan2026@gmail.com. Key wins: Compliance shows 948 controls across 6 frameworks with fw-risk-<id>/fw-score-<id>/fixLine/AI pill; framework select defaults to '__every__' with all 8 options; 6 crosswalk-summary cards show score AND %; crosswalk-criticality shows 'all mapped controls · 24 controls'; 4 crit-tier tiles; crit-tier click switches mode to '__grid__' and filters rows; grid crosswalk-row opens control-detail-modal with AIFix (ai-fix-rating loaded from /advisor/fix). AI Analyst header present on ALL 8 dashboards with 'Analyze' button label (unique = {'Analyze'}) and 4-5 auto-loaded insight bullets: compliance-posture, situation-room, control-monitoring, ai-agents, spend-governance, knowledge-graph, cyber-risk-fair, Cyber-Risk-Register. Clickable AI details work: Situation sr-exposure-LR-001 → situation-risk-modal + ai-fix-rating='Critical RISK · 74/100'; Control Monitoring control-card-IAM-3 → ai-fix-rating='Medium RISK · 27/100'; Cyber-Risk cyber-stat-posture → cyber-metric-modal with ai-explain-summary+recommendation; cyber-risk-LR-001 row → cyber-risk-modal + ai-fix-rating='Critical RISK · 74/100'; Knowledge Graph react-flow node click → kg-node-modal + ai-explain (vendor/non-risk node); Spend Governance sg-month-card → sg-detail-modal + ai-explain-summary.

ui_bugs.issue: Playwright click on framework summary card sometimes doesn't switch mode from '__every__' to the framework (state stayed at '__every__' after click). Might be a stale-modal-backdrop timing issue; JS-invoked el.click() works. Real user with normal mouse should be fine, but selector-based Playwright automation is flaky.

Framework controls without an Obserra mapping (e.g. AC-1 met by default) show only a static control-modal-note, NOT the AI risk rating. Acceptance criteria implied every control row must expose ai-fix-rating. Currently only rows with focus.obserraId render AIFix; unmapped 'met-by-default' framework controls do not.

issues: Hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — <option> uses span/em for styling which triggers React hydration warning in console.

advisor_endpoints: POST /api/advisor/fix (control ref IAM-3) → rating/score/rationale w/ 'effectiveness … baseline' line
POST /api/advisor/insight scoped for 5 dashboards; FAIR headline ≠ Register headline
compliance: crosswalk-criticality header shows 'all mapped controls · 24 controls'

clickable_cards.knowledge-graph: react-flow__node click → kg-node-modal + ai-explain (non-risk vendor node)
clickable_cards.spend-governance: sg-month-card → sg-detail-modal + ai-explain-summary; sg-user-<email> rows also present

critical_code_review_comments: The review request lists URLs '/app/control-monitoring' and '/app/ai-agents' but the App.js Router uses '/app/controls' and '/app/agents'. AppShell links use the same actual paths, so this is a doc-only mismatch — not a code bug — but any external link/documentation using the doc URLs will 404 (falls through to Navigate to '/'). Consider adding legacy route redirects.

ControlDetailModal only renders AIFix when focus.obserraId is present. For a framework control that has NO Obserra mapping and status='met', the modal shows only a static blurb — no ai-fix-rating. If the acceptance requires EVERY control row to expose an AI risk rating + recommendation, wire up an AIExplain fallback (kind='framework-control', context={framework, requirement, status, why}) so unmapped controls still get an AI-generated view.

Radix Select for framework-select renders <span>/<em> inside <option>, which React emits a hydration warning for. Move rich formatting outside <option> or use a custom Radix Select (SelectItem) instead of native <select>.

Knowledge Graph nodes rendered by ReactFlow lack per-node data-testid; automation must fall back to '.react-flow__node' CSS. Add data-testid={`kg-node-${n.id}`} on the node component to align with the naming convention used everywhere else.

Cyber-Risk table row <tr data-testid='cyber-risk-*'> click doesn't reliably fire the React onClick under Playwright's force-click (works with el.click() via evaluate). Wrap the row content in a <button>/[role=button] or move the click handler to a <td> to improve testability and a11y (keyboard access).

ControlMonitoring exposes 'control-card-<id>' only inside a mobile-only container (hidden at ≥md widths). At desktop widths those cards are `not visible` even though the DOM has them. Add a desktop-visible testid (e.g. `control-row-<id>` on the table row) to keep parity.
action_items: Decide: should framework controls WITHOUT an Obserra mapping still show an AI risk rating? If yes, wire AIExplain fallback into ControlDetailModal for the 'note' branch. Currently only ~24 mapped Obserra controls get AI ratings.
Fix hydration warning: remove <span>/<em> from inside <option> in crosswalk-framework-select.
Add data-testid on ReactFlow KG nodes (kg-node-<id>) and desktop control rows (control-row-<id>) for QA.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all core criteria verified; 2 minor testability/design comments

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT URL CORRECTION: /app/controls (NOT /app/control-monitoring) and /app/agents (NOT /app/ai-agents). Both other paths hit the 404 catch-all and only render sidebar. Auth: login form is at root; use `page.locator('input[type=password]').first.press('Enter')` after filling. Skip onboarding tour with role=button name=Skip. AI Insight auto-runs on mount — wait up to 25s for ai-insight-item-* nodes. For clicking table rows (cyber-risk-*, sr-exposure-*) prefer JS click via page.evaluate(el.click()) instead of playwright .click() to reliably fire React onClick. Control-card-IAM-3 lives inside 'control-cards-mobile' container hidden at desktop widths — use JS click or shrink viewport <768px. ReactFlow KG nodes have no per-node testid; use '.react-flow__node' selector. LLM calls to /advisor/{fix,insight,explain} take 5-15s (cached 3-5 min server-side); use 25-30s timeouts on ai-fix-rating/ai-explain-summary. Framework-summary card click sometimes doesn't switch mode due to stale-modal-backdrop timing — use el.click() JS fallback.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical bugs. Documentation URL mismatch (/app/control-monitoring vs /app/controls) caused first pass to appear to miss AIInsight; corrected URLs revealed everything works.
